2609.00709.title: Controllable Image Captioning with Prompt-Conditioned Scene Rewards
2609.00709.paper_summary: Large Vision-Language Models produce fluent image descriptions but offer limited semantic control: users cannot reliably specify whether captions should emphasize attributes, relations, or particular image regions. We present Fine-grained Captioning Control Using Scene Rewards (FoCUS), a controllable image captioning method that lets users steer captions toward specific semantic emphases through natural-language control prompts. The core idea is a prompt-conditioned control objective based on scene-graph-aligned component scores. Generated captions are parsed and aligned to scene-graph components such as objects, attributes, and relations. These components are differentially weighted, including negative weights, according to the requested emphasis. We optimize this objective with GRPO and further improve its reliability through a stricter object validity threshold and reasoning-based verification for attribute and relation scoring. To evaluate controllability, we introduce Semantic Control and Precision Evaluation (SCoPE), a benchmark with contrastive Include/Avoid constraints for measuring both target content coverage and out-of-scope suppression. Experiments on two VLM backbones show that FoCUS consistently improves controllability and fine-grained caption quality without degrading general caption performance.
2609.00709.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺-語言模型能生成流暢的圖像描述，但提供的語義控制有限：用戶無法可靠地指定標題是否應強調屬性、關係或特定圖像區域。我們提出了使用場景獎勵的細粒度標題控制方法（FoCUS），這是一種可控的圖像標題生成方法，允許用戶通過自然語言控制提示來引導標題朝向特定的語義重點。其核心思想是基於場景圖對齊的組件分數的提示條件控制目標。生成的標題會被解析並對齊到場景圖組件，如物體、屬性和關係。這些組件根據請求的重點進行差異加權，包括負權重。我們使用GRPO來優化這一目標，並通過更嚴格的物體有效性閾值和基於推理的屬性和關係評分驗證進一步提高其可靠性。為了評估可控性，我們引入了語義控制和精確度評估（SCoPE），這是一個具有對比性包含/避免約束的基準，用於測量目標內容覆蓋和範圍外抑制。對兩個VLM骨幹的實驗顯示，FoCUS始終改善可控性和細粒度標題質量，而不降低一般標題性能。
